Our People As of January 2026, Avocado employs 698 people across manufacturing, retail, and corporate operations. 7.3% have been with Avocado for ten years or more — a retention figure that reflects what it means to work for a company where the mission is in the product you build with your hands every day. For more on our sourcing partnerships — organic latex from India and Guatemala, certified organic wool from the Himalayas, organic cotton from four countries — see Inside an Avocado Organic Mattress in our Impact Report. Our Tecate Factory Our Los Angeles Factory Our Farm to Mattress Ethos Did this answer your question?

Avocado Green Mattress was cofounded by Jeff D'Andrea, Dan D'Andrea, Jay Decker, and Mark Abrials. The brand launched in 2016 after the founders set out to find a genuinely certified organic mattress at an accessible price — and found greenwashing and unverifiable claims instead. That experience shaped the brand's commitment to independent certification, public verification, and radical transparency about materials and manufacturing. When was Avocado Green Mattress founded? The Avocado brand launched in 2016. In 2018, Avocado completed a merger with Brentwood Home — a Los Angeles mattress manufacturer that has been handcrafting mattresses since 1987 — forming Avocado Green Brands.

The Avocado brand launched in 2016 and merged with Brentwood Home in 2018. That gives our manufacturing operation over 35 years of craft heritage — hand needle-tufting, in-house coil manufacturing, and traditional bedmaking techniques — now operating under GOTS finished-product certification and the full Avocado organic standard. Is Avocado a B Corp? Yes. Avocado has been a Certified B Corporation since 2014, with a current Impact Score of 113.9 — "Best for the World" recognition and nearly double the 80-point certification threshold. The average score for certified B Corps is approximately 96.

OUR BRAND MISSION: ORGANIC, SAFE, & RESPONSIBLE Avocado mattresses are designed in Hoboken and handmade in our GOTS-certified factory in Fullerton, California, with domestic and imported certified organic materials. Every mattress holds GOTS finished-product certification — independently audited from farm through manufacturing, not just the materials inside it. Our mission is to be the most trusted source for certified organic mattresses, pillows, and bedding at accessible prices — while holding ourselves to verified environmental, ethical, and social standards across our entire supply chain.

Natural, Organic, & Beyond Our mission is to be one of the world’s most sustainable brands. Our green mattresses and bedding are certified organic and non-toxic. Our materials include GOLS certified organic latex, GOTS certified organic wool, GOTS certified organic cotton, and GOTS certified organic kapok fiber. Our factory and wood shop in Los Angeles are GOTS organic and FSC® certified — and powered entirely by renewable energy. We are the world’s only Climate Neutral Certified® mattress and bedding brand. Most of our products are Greenguard Gold and MADE SAFE® certified. We donate one percent of all revenues to environmental nonprofits through our membership with 1% For The Planet.
Newly Certified B Corp Avocado Mattress Launches Memorial Day Sale on Organic Mattresses MAY 8, 2020 ## Sustainable Mattress Maker Avocado Green Launches New Organic Crib Mattress APRIL 22, 2020

Who Makes Avocado Mattresses? Avocado does. Every Avocado organic mattress is hand-needle-tufted by skilled bedmakers in our own GOTS-certified manufacturing facility in Fullerton, California — not by a contract manufacturer or a third-party factory shared with other brands. That distinction matters more than it might seem. Many direct-to-consumer mattress brands are marketing and logistics operations: they design products, build websites, and manage customer relationships, but the mattresses themselves are made by contract manufacturers who produce for multiple brands simultaneously. Avocado is a bedmaker.

A Force for Good Avocado is a Certified B Corporation®, a new kind of business that balances purpose and profit. We are legally required to consider the impact of our decisions on our workers, customers, suppliers, community, and the environment. B Corporations are a community of leaders, driving a global movement of people using business as a force for good.

TO BE A TRULY SUSTAINABLE BRAND Now, we're raising the bar for what it means to be a sustainable brand. We’re a certified B Corp and Climate Neutral certified. Plus, we donate 1% of revenues to vetted nonprofits through our commitment to 1% For the Planet. Our products are organic certified by GOTS. We don’t use toxic chemicals. Our factories are powered by renewable energy and are approaching zero waste. We even care for nearly 200,000 sheep and grow and produce our own natural latex from our own farms. And the journey has just begun.
